result.title: Func-JEPA: Learning a Sobolev Space of Functions as Latent Vectors
result.comment: 42 pages, 16 figures, 30 tables. Code: https://github.com/amorarc/Func-JEPA. Model and data: https://huggingface.co/amorarc/func-jepa
result.summary: Pretraining an encoder once and reusing it across tasks is a widespread approach in vision and language. However, neural symbolic mathematics still trains a dedicated sequence-to-sequence model for each task, so that no representation of a function is shared. In this work, we propose the Function Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (Func-JEPA, abbreviated f-JEPA): an encoder of mathematical functions, pretrained on their symbolic form, whose latent space imitates the Sobolev space H^1 and in which differentiation is a learned latent operator. The norm of a latent is computed exactly from the function, whereas its direction is learned to match Sobolev angles. The frozen encoder is then reused by lightweight modules for decoding, composition, integration, and regression from samples. The representation and four downstream tasks are evaluated within and outside the pretraining distribution. f-JEPA recovers exact formulas from noisy samples more often than the compared symbolic-regression methods, whereas computer algebra and task-specific models remain stronger on standard integration and differential-equation benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Func-JEPA，在数学函数的符号形式上预训练一个 JEPA 式编码器，使 latent 空间模仿 Sobolev 空间 H^1，并把求导实现为学习到的 latent 算子；随后冻结编码器，用轻量模块完成解码、复合、积分与从噪声样本回归。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「latent 空间具有可解释几何、并在其中学习算子而非逐步生成」的思路，可能为 LVR 中推理状态的表示结构与状态更新算子设计提供核查线索，但与视觉证据、停止决策等主线问题距离较远。
